voiceSummary: The Great Eastern Shipping Company Limited has uploaded the audio recording of its earnings call conducted on November 11, 2026, at 04:00 p.m. This filing is pursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations 2015. The audio file is available on the company website at the specified link. The announcement serves as information and records for BSE Limited and the National Stock Exchange of India Limited.

attchmntText: The Great Eastern Shipping Company Limited has informed the Exchange about Investor Presentation
sm_name: The Great Eastern Shipping Company Limited
voiceSummary: The Great Eastern Shipping Company Limited filed an investor presentation for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. Consolidated net profit was INR 1,269 Crores and standalone net profit was INR 1,027 Crores. Consolidated cash profit stood at INR 1,522 Crores. Net asset value per share was INR 2,224 on a consolidated basis and INR 1,787 on a standalone basis. The company declared an interim dividend of INR 14.40 per share. This marks the 19th consecutive quarterly dividend. Revenue was INR 1,702 Crores on a standalone basis and INR 2,234 Crores on a consolidated basis for the quarter. Gross debt was INR 800 Crores on a standalone basis and INR 800 Crores on a consolidated basis.

attchmntText: The Great Eastern Shipping Company Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 06, 2026, titled "Further to our letter dated October 23, 2026, we wish to inform you that the Company took delivery of 2015 built secondhand Very Large Gas Carrier  Jag Vikrant  of about 82,000 cbm. The Company had contracted to buy the vessel in Q3 FY27.".
